card.name: Words just before a dose number
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or digits right before a quantity or dose figure, such as 'a dose of', 'prior to' or a space before a number. Mostly in drug-label text on dosing and fertility treatment.

modes.label: Before an amount
modes.description: A space or small word sits right before a number of mg or units.

modes.label: Dose-setting words
modes.description: The word 'a', 'to' or the first digit in a hCG dose or timing instruction.
modes.example: Final oocyte maturation is induced with<< a>> dose of 5,000

modes.label: Linking word in warnings
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'metabolism' in an ACE inhibitor warning.
modes.example: affect the metabolism<< of>> eicosanoids and polypeptides

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to write a number or a headache or food-related term next, though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or space just before a dose amount or timing figure in a label.
